rationale: Text-only items rendered in a single auto-scrolling horizontal strip with dot separators; the block duplicates items for the loop.
visualCharacteristics.purpose: auto-scrolling horizontal marquee of text labels with dot separators

contentPattern.description: Repeating set of look-alike labels rendered as an animated marquee; no library marquee, so Cards (no images) carries the items. Author the 10 unique labels once (source duplicates them for looping); separators are decorative.
contentPattern.structure: one row per label, one cell of plain text. Author each label once; the block duplicates them for the loop and adds the separators

cells: Text content (empty for cards-gallery; label for cards-ticker)

usage: Use as a decorative strip between sections listing activities or keywords.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for any looping text marquee. Motion stops for users who prefer reduced motion.
